title: The Terminal of the Kuiper Line
author: Dominic Yarrow
blurb: Sebastian Blackwood, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
